name: KungFu_1
short_caption: The robot mimics a classic Kung Fu martial arts stance, raising its right hand to face-level while turning its torso and head.
movement_description: The robot begins by raising both arms up, drawing its right hand open near its face and its left hand slightly forward and down in a classic defensive martial arts posture. It tilts its head and twists its torso slightly to its left, holding this static Kung Fu stance for a brief moment. Finally, the robot lowers both arms back down to its sides and returns its head and torso to a straight-facing neutral position.
safety_notes: The robot's arms extend outward to the front and right; ensure the immediate workspace is clear of close objects.
